notes.title: The demo is available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Hey everyone! I have some great news! The demo version of Blood of the Inquisition is now available on Steam, and you can download it right now!

The path to redemption is thorny, but can you stay on it when so many temptations lie ahead?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148620/Blood_of_Inquisition_Demo/

Enjoy the game!
